title: Openings below grade.
officialText:
Where openings below grade provide required natural ventilation, the outside
horizontal clear space measured perpendicular to the opening shall be one and one-half times the depth of the
opening. The depth of the opening shall be measured from the average adjoining ground level to the bottom of the
opening.
